title: Oahu: Mauka Warriors Luau, Rum Tasting and Dole Plantation Tour
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Children must be accompanied by an adult
Valid photo ID required (ages 21+ for rum tasting and luau bar service)
policies: The tour operates rain or shine
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Experience Oʻahu through a premium full-day journey that blends iconic island flavors, cultural heritage, and an authentic Hawaiian luau. 

Begin at the historic Dole Plantation, where you can enjoy a signature Dole Whip and locally inspired pineapple treats set against the backdrop of the island’s agricultural legacy.

Continue to Kō Hana Distillers for a guided rum tasting featuring handcrafted spirits made from heirloom Hawaiian sugarcane, offering a refined look into the island’s traditions and craftsmanship.

As evening sets in, conclude your day at an authentic Hawaiian luau featuring a curated buffet and a live performance of traditional music, hula, and fire dancing.

Round-trip transportation from Waikiki is included, ensuring a seamless and elevated experience from start to finish—an effortless way to discover the culture, flavors, and spirit of Oʻahu in one signature journey.
